  • Constructor Details

    • Vehicle

      public Vehicle(Vehicle.MakeName initialMake, String initialModel, double initialPrice, int initialProductionYear, int numberOfPassengers) throws ValidationException.InvalidString, ValidationException.NullObject, ValidationException.NegativeDouble, ValidationException.InvalidDate, ValidationException.FullArray, ValidationException.NotEnough
      Construct a vehicle with necessary data.
      Parameters:
      initialMake - MakeName Make.
      initialModel - String Model.
      initialPrice - double Price. Should be positive.
      initialProductionYear - int Production year. Should be positive.
      numberOfPassengers - int Array size for arrayOfPassengers. Should be positive.
      Throws:
      ValidationException.InvalidString - When initialModel's length is 0.
      ValidationException.NullObject - When make is null.
      ValidationException.NegativeDouble - When price is negative.
      ValidationException.InvalidDate - When production year is in the future or earlier that FIRST_VEHICLE_PATENT_YEAR due to obvious reason.
      ValidationException.FullArray - When there is already an arrayOfPassenger.
      ValidationException.NotEnough - When there are passengers inside the vehicle.

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Vehicle that)
      Overridden method for compareTo. Return 1 if that is null. The comparing process follows the following order: 1. Make 2. Model 3. Price 4. Production Year Return 0 only if the above 4 are 0.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Vehicle>
      Parameters:
      that - Vehicle Compared object.
      Returns:
      0 if equal. 1 if higher. -1 if lower.
